entities.title: No path restriction
entities.summary: The operations read any path the daemon's user may read, absolute or relative to the caller's working directory.
entities.impact: An agent given shell-tools can read every file the user can, including outside the project; only the operating system's permissions limit it.
entities.workaround: Run shell-tools as a user, or in a sandbox, that can read only what the agent should see.

entities.title: Memory in the daemon only
entities.summary: Unchanged markers and diffs exist only while the daemon runs and only within a session; a call without a session remembers nothing.
entities.impact: A daemon restart, or 64 newer sessions, makes the next repeat send content in full.

entities.title: Matching lines, not matches
entities.summary: search uses the daemon's find scan: a line with several matches counts once, binary files and files over 2 MiB are skipped.
entities.impact: total_matches is a count of lines; a match in a large file is not found.
entities.workaround: zazzle read or a narrower path for large files.

entities.title: Binary means a NUL in the first 8000 bytes
entities.summary: A file is treated as binary only when its first 8000 bytes hold a NUL byte.
entities.impact: Binary files are not read as lines, searched or outlined; UTF-16 text counts as binary, and a binary file without an early NUL is treated as text.

entities.title: Unix only
entities.summary: The code uses Unix file metadata (std::os::unix), so it builds only on Unix-like systems.

entities.title: Session tables are cleared, not trimmed
entities.summary: The stamp and sent tables (200,000 entries) are emptied whole when they reach their limit; diff bases are evicted oldest first past 64 MiB.
entities.impact: In a very long or very broad session, a repeat right after a clear is answered in full and recomputed rather than with an unchanged marker or a cache hit.

entities.title: One JSON call at a time
entities.summary: The daemon runs JSON requests under one lock, so a long search from one session delays another session's call.
entities.impact: Concurrent `zazzle call`s wait for each other; text commands do not.
